title: Qt: Open the Preferences dialog help section for the current pane
description:
Have the Preferences dialog go to the WSUG page for the current
pane, if it has one, instead of the top Preferences dialog section.

This commit handles the special Preference dialog items. Follow-up
is needed to associate a help URL with the preference modules upon
registration (similar to what is already done for UATs.)

Ping #19176

commits_data.title: prefs: Add help URLs for the modules added normally
commits_data.message:
prefs: Add help URLs for the modules added normally

Add help URLs for the modules added to the Preference Dialog normally,
like Protocols, Name Resolution, and Statistics.

Have modules that don't (yet) have an individual WSUG page use the
first ancestor that does have a help page.

Ping #19176
